description: Emoji echo glyphs for game-facing Aurora names (lore-bible §6.3). Each glyph annotates a witnessed fact: 🧊 ice-witnessed/preserved/twice-hatched; ✨ aurora-light/blessing/seer-work; ❄️ frost ordeal/survival/scar; 📜 ledger/trade/oath/procedure; ⚔️ war/defense/slaying. 🪞 ancestor-echo is handled by separate grammar rules with an explicit ancestor reference name. Generated/UI names emit the bare glyph only. The word forms (twice-hatched, light-bearer, frost-scarred, trade-blessed, defender) remain valid in ceremonial/archive prose, but are not used in game-facing display.
